title: Retire repo-root and docs clutter: three briefs (one with pre-ladder pricing), SEO-AEO-PLAN status prose and the retired DAWN handoff folder

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: MARKETING-BRIEF.md (22 KB, its own banner says SUPERSEDED on pricing by ADR-1709), funnels-brief.md (12 KB), claude-design-briefs.md (15 KB) are not in scripts/planning-docs.txt (0 matches). ROADMAP.md (16 KB, SUPERSEDED 2026-05-31) and SEO-AEO-PLAN.md are registered. design_handoff/BRIEF-04 and BRIEF-00 plus .claude/agents/funnel-architect.md reference them. || /home/user/frequency-web/SEO-AEO-PLAN.md:1-14 ('Phases 1-3 COMPLETE'); live crawl map is app/robots.ts and app/sitemap.ts, which now cover llms.txt, IndexNow (app/api/cron/indexnow), local index floor, town pages, which the plan does not mention. || design_handoff/SYNC.md:3 'DAWN is retired as a deployable design... pnpm design:use dawn exits 2'. design_handoff/dawn 5.1 MB, frequency 6.5 MB, plus 8 BRIEF-* docs and two HANDOFF-TO-DAWN files. CLAUDE.md still says 'When I say sync DAWN, follow design_handoff/SYNC.md'.

WHY IT MATTERS: A pre-ladder price list at the top level is what an agent or contractor reads first and quotes. Root clutter also breaks the 'one list' canon the repo enforces. Plan contradicts the one-list rule (status in prose) and gives no launch-day GSC/Bing submission checklist or local-SEO phase. An agent told 'sync DAWN' does a round of work on a retired design. Mostly weight, minor risk.

FIX DIRECTION: Move the three briefs under docs/marketing/ (or design_handoff/), fix the three referrers, delete or fold ROADMAP.md into history. Add a launch SEO runbook (GSC + Bing submit, GBP, town pages) as backlog rows and add a SUPERSEDED banner or point it at the JSON; move the file under docs/. Update CLAUDE.md to say sync DAWN is history only, or drop the dawn bundle once regression tests stop reading it.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
